# weka_object_store_bucket (Resource)

An object store bucket, and how the cluster reaches it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "weka_object_store_bucket" "cold" {
  name     = "cold"
  obs_name = "default"

  obs_site    = "local"
  obs_type    = "AWS"
  protocol    = "HTTPS"
  hostname    = "s3.example.com"
  port        = 443
  bucket      = "cold-data"
  auth_method = "AWSSignature4"
  region      = "us-east-1"

  access_key_id = "placeholder-access-key"
  secret_key    = "placeholder-secret-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Object store bucket name. Renaming updates in place.
- `obs_name` (String) Object store this bucket belongs to. Changing it updates in place.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID for AWS Signature authentication. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method: None, AWSSignature2, or AWSSignature4. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name in the object store. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname or IP of the object store endpoint. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `obs_site` (String) Site of the bucket (local or remote). The update API has no field for this, so a change recreates the bucket. Server default on create; removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `obs_type` (String) Object store type. AWS when omitted. The update API has no field for this, so a change recreates the bucket. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `port` (Number) Port of the object store endpoint. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol used to reach the object store. HTTP when omitted. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `region` (String) Region the bucket is assigned to. Usually empty. Removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret key for AWS Signature authentication. When a read omits this, Terraform keeps the configured value and does not plan a change.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object store bucket UID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UID.
terraform import weka_object_store_bucket.cold cold
```
